al_azar: A book on the basics:
"You may attach only 1 Energy card from your hand per turn."
A book on Supporters:
"You can play only 1 Supporter card per turn. Play it, then it goes to the discard pile at the end of your turn."
A book on Evolution:
"You can't evolve a Pokémon on the turn you put it into play, or on your first turn."
A book on Weakness:
"Weakness doubles the damage. Resistance takes away 30."
A book on Special Conditions:
"A Poisoned Pokémon gets 1 damage counter between turns."
"A Burned Pokémon: flip a coin between turns. If tails, put 2 damage counters on it."
A book on Special Conditions:
"Asleep: flip a coin between turns. If heads, it wakes up."
"Paralyzed: it can't attack or retreat until the end of your next turn."
A book on Special Conditions:
"Confused: flip a coin when it attacks. If tails, the attack fails and it gets 3 damage counters."
A book on Pokémon-ex:
"When your Pokémon-ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards."
A book on retreating:
"To retreat, discard Energy equal to the Retreat Cost. You can retreat only once per turn."
A book on Poké-Powers and Poké-Bodies:
"Poké-Powers are used once per turn. Poké-Bodies work all the time, as long as the Pokémon is in play."
A book called "Building Your First Deck".
"60 cards, and no more than 4 copies of a card with the same name, except basic Energy."
A picture book about Hoenn's Pokémon.
There's a Zigzagoon running across every page.
